sufficient_sets.text: They tend to live in troops, with the leader being called a silverback.
The species lives in groups which can number over 200 members, although individuals travel and forage in much smaller groups during the day.
Chimpanzees live in a strict male-dominated hierarchy, where disputes are generally settled without the need for violence.
